items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had – Terry Gibbs was the vibraphone player. Lou Levy was the piano player. Oscar Pettiford was the bass player.

ctx.x: Let’s go back and talk about that sextet that you co-led with Charlie Shavers. Who else was in that band?
I had – Terry Gibbs was the vibraphone player. Lou Levy was the piano player. Oscar Pettiford was the bass player.
